quests.title: Quest Python Data Forge
quests.briefing_md:
# Data Forge

Messy data is the enemy of stable systems. In this quest, you will build a **Data Forge** to normalize raw, inconsistent record entries into a canonical format.

### Your Objective
Implement `normalize_record` to:
1.  Ensure all IDs are integers.
2.  Sanitize names (trim whitespace).
3.  Default missing phone numbers to `null`.

quests.title: Quest Python Loop
quests.briefing_md:
# Python Loops

Automation starts with **Iteration**. You will use Python's `for` loops and range logic to process a sequence of numbers and calculate aggregate statistics.

### Your Objective
Write a loop that identifies even numbers between 1 and 10 and prints a final count of matching records.

quests.title: Quest Python Systems Service Boundaries
quests.briefing_md:
# Service Boundaries

Architectural integrity depends on strict **Service Boundaries**. You will implement a Repository pattern to abstract data storage away from business logic.

### Your Objective
Implement an `InMemoryTicketRepo` and a `close_ticket` service that ensures data only enters the system through established contracts.

quests.title: Quest Python Systems Resilient Job Runner
quests.briefing_md:
# Resilient Job Runner

Distributed systems are flaky. You must build a **Resilient Job Runner** that handles transient network failures using sophisticated retry strategies.

### Your Objective
Implement a retry loop that differentiates between `TransientError` (should retry) and `FatalError` (should stop immediately).

quests.title: Quest Python Systems Observability Sli
quests.briefing_md:
# Observability & SLIs

You can't fix what you can't measure. In this quest, you will implement **Service Level Indicators (SLIs)** to monitor the health of your processing engine.

### Your Objective
Calculate availability and latency SLIs based on a stream of system execution logs.

quests.title: Quest Python Systems Performance Profile
quests.briefing_md:
# Performance Profiling

Optimization without measurement is a guess. You will use **Profiling** techniques to identify the "Hot Path" in a slow data processing script.

### Your Objective
Identify the O(n²) bottleneck in the provided script and optimize it using set-based lookups to reach O(n) efficiency.

quests.title: Quest Python Systems Platform Tooling
quests.briefing_md:
# Platform Tooling

Empower your team by building **Internal Tooling**. You will create a suite of utility functions to automate developer friction points like slugification and unique sorting.

### Your Objective
Develop a robust `slugify` utility and a `unique_sorted` helper that follows strict engineering rules.
